title: Fertilia: Update 7
author: BYTE Play Devs
excerpt: Christmas Event: Part 1 is here! Unlock 4 new upgrades, collect decorations for your tree, and farm the new FESTIVE variant for Christmas Coins!

content.html: The Christmas Event: Part 1 is here!
Farmed globally, the new FESTIVE crop variant is here!
Selling these yields Christmas Coins!
The value of these will always be $1, but can be increased by upgrading!
Use your limited Christmas Coins here!
Includes tons of items, including the LIMITED CHRISTMAS Hoe and CHRISTMAS Sword!
Also includes useful, rare items like Seed Feed, Sprout Bone, Potion Bundles.
The strongest and greatest of weapons and tools!
The CHRISTMAS Hoe increases chances for Festive crops!
The CHRISTMAS Sword boasts as a Sharpness IV Netherite Sword!
This makes it the strongest weapon in FERTILIA!
Also drops globally!
Use candycanes in the new Christmas Upgrades!
Used to decorate your tree!
Different decorations award more points!
Christmas Globe — 3 points
Christmas Stocking — 12 points
Christmas Candle — 36 points
Every hour depending on your decoration points, receive TONS OF ITEMS!
Boost your way with these limited upgrades!
Includes decoration drop chance upgrades, santa shop discounts, and christmas coins multi!
You'll want tons of candycanes for these!
A new feature fit for the holiday season!
Send items to your friends or foes, even when they're offline!
You may hold up to 40 items in your mailbox before it gets full.
He's filling up YOUR MAILBOX!
Every 30 minutes, santa is sending presents to your mailbox!
The first MEDALLION CHARM of this season!
Most decorated trees for the whole week will be given SPECIAL REWARDS!
#1 — MEDALLION charm, 6x Exclusive Chorus Flower
#2 — SYNTHESIS charm, 20x Enchant Relic, 3x Exclusive Chorus Flower, 4x INSANE Water Sprinkler
#3 — 15x Enchant Relic, 2x Exclusive Chorus Flower
Useful to boost your way through the event!
Contains tons of Christmas Coins and limited items!
Can be found in Travelling Merchant, hourly tree decoration rewards, Exclusive Raffle and random drops!
When obtained from random drops, it'll be announced in GLOBAL CHAT!

items: Mini Bags can now be bulk opened with Sneak + Right Click
Infinity Hoe can no longer be enchanted
Exotic Fruit Tier 7 trade now gives 2x Bastion Fruit seed instead of 1
Halved price of Crop Duster in Exotic Fruits
Welcome reward is now mailbox instead of a chat message
Rustic enchant now works as intended
Changed Igneous variant table to Burnt: 70%, Molten 30%

content.text: Good luck! Christmas Event Part 2 next week!
